p0.original: 关键问题：人格由哪些稳定的行为模式或特质组成
p0.en: Key issues: what is a stable pattern of behaviour or character of personality?

p2.original: 所有特质理论都会提出某些人格特征（如气质、特质或人格类型），这些特征会使人们的人格随时间的流逝保持稳定不变。
p2.en: All qualitative theories suggest certain personality characteristics (e.g., quality, quality or type of personality) that can keep the human personality stable at any time.

p3.original: 在科学心理学尚未出现的两千年前，根据希腊医生希波克拉底（Hippocrates）提出的体液（humors）学说，人们将气质分成四种类型。希波克拉底认为，一个人的气质是由人体分泌的四种体液之间的平衡决定的。多血质的人热血和温润，其特点源于血液。胆汁质的人易怒，其特点源于肝脏分泌的黄色胆汁。抑郁质的人忧郁，其特点源自脾脏产生的黑胆汁。最后，黏液质的人平静、冷漠、懒散、不情绪化，其特点源自黏液。希波克拉底的生物学理论可能并不准确，但他关于气质的概念已经成了“常识”。即使在今天，你也会偶尔看到人们用他的术语来描述人格。
p3.en: Before the advent of scientific psychology 2,000 years ago, the gas was divided into four types, according to the humors doctrine of Greek doctor Hippocrates. The Hippocrates believe that the quality of a person is determined by the balance between the four body fluids of humans. Blood-intensive humans are hot and warm, and their characteristics are from blood. Courage-based people are angry and are characterized by liver-scrutinized yellow juice. The depression is characterized by a spleen-generated black juice. Finally, mucous humans are calm, cold, lazy and unemotional, characterized by slime. Hippocratic biology may not be accurate, but his concept of gas has become “common sense”. Even today, you will see occasionally that people use his term to describe their personality.

p4.original: 现代社会也出现了其他的人格分类系统。最简单的人格分类是刻板印象，如胖子往往是乐天派、工程师保守、女性富有同情心。显然，这些分类对人格模式的复杂问题来说过于简单化了。这种分类和刻板印象还包括大学专业、性别、种族，以及诚实、友善、幽默感等品质。而在今天，如果你严格按照这些简化的分类和刻板印象来理解他人，你可能就会感到有点愧疚。
p4.en: Other personal classification systems have emerged in modern societies. The simplest classification of personality is stereotypes, such as fats, who are often musical, engineers conservative and women sympathetic. Clearly, these classifications are too simplistic for the complex issue of the personality model. This classification and stereotyping also includes university specialization, gender, race, and the qualities of honesty, goodwill, humor, etc. And today, you may feel a little guilty if you understand others in strict accordance with these simplified classifications and stereotypes.

p5.original: 希波克拉底是身心关系理论的早期贡献者。他的观点是每个人的气质都是由我们的优势体液决定的；优势体液可能是血液、黄胆汁、黑胆汁或黏液中的任何一种。
p5.en: Hippocrates was an early contributor to the theory of physical and mental relations. His view is that each person's air quality is determined by our superior body fluids; Advantage fluids may be any of the blood, yellow juice, black juice or slime.

p6.original: 尽管如此，人类仍然存在着一种将复杂问题简化的认知倾向，因而常常会把他人归类分组。因此，一些人格心理学家试图采用少数几种基本气质（temperament）来描述人。所谓气质，就是具有很强生物学基础的人格特质，如“外向”或“羞怯”。另一些人格心理学家更喜欢用特质（trait）组合来描述。所谓特质，通常被认为是人格的多个维度（如谨慎和鲁莽、友善和不友善），并更多地受到经验学习而非先天气质的影响。还有一些人格心理学家依据人格类型（personality type）对人们进行分类。这是类别的概念，而非维度的概念。也就是说，你要么属于某种类型，要么不属于这种类型。举例来说，如果内向是一种特质维度（trait dimension），人们在内向维度上的表现只是程度上的差异；但如果内向是一种类型，那么人们往往就会被归类为内向的或非内向的人。
p6.en: Despite this, there is still a perceived tendency to simplify complex issues and, as a result, to group people into groups. Thus, some personality psychologists have tried to describe people by using a few basic qualities (temperament). The gas is a personality character with a strong biological foundation, such as “outside” or “weakness”. Other personality psychologists prefer to describe it in combination with traits. Characteristics are often considered to be multiple dimensions of personality (such as caution and recklessness, goodwill and unfriendlyness) and are more influenced by experience learning than by weather. There are also personality psychologists who classify people according to their type of personality (personality type). This is the concept of categories, not dimensions. In other words, you either belong to a certain type or you don't. For example, if an internal orientation is a characteristic dimension, the performance of people in the internal dimension is only a degree of variation; But if inward orientation is a type, then people are often classified as inward or non-introverted.

p7.original: 虽然这些人格理论各有不同，但是核心概念表明，它们也有一些共同的基础。
p7.en: While these personality theories vary, core concepts suggest that they also have some common ground.

p8.original: 所有特质理论都会提出某些人格特征（如气质、特质或人格类型），这些特征会使人们的人格随时间的流逝保持稳定不变。
p8.en: All qualitative theories suggest certain personality characteristics (e.g., quality, quality or type of personality) that can keep the human personality stable at any time.

p9.original: 因为气质、特质和人格类型的概念有所重叠，所以，我们会根据传统习惯将它们统称为特质理论（dispositional theory）。但是，这些理论与刻板印象（如保守的工程师、阳刚的男性，环保主义的教授）有何不同呢？答案是科学性。好的气质理论、特质理论或类型理论必须具有坚实的科学基础。在科学的视角下，我们从气质开始讨论这些人格理论。
p9.en: Because of the overlap between the concepts of quality, character and personality type, we will refer to them collectively as the theory of quality (dispositional theory) in accordance with traditional customs. But how are these theories different from stereotypes (e.g. conservative engineers, masculinist men, environmentalists professors)? The answer is scientific. Good gas theory, quality theory or type theory must have a solid scientific basis. From a scientific point of view, we begin to discuss these personality theories from a physical point of view.

p16.original: 解释生物学基础和学习经验对气质的作用。
p16.en: Explain the role of biological foundations and learning experience in the atmosphere.

p17.original: 心理学家将气质定义为具有生物学基础的人格特质。它通常在儿童早期就表现出来，是人格和个体生活态度的基础（Hogan et al.，1996；Mischel，1993）。
p17.en: Psychologists define gas as personality qualities with a biological basis. It is usually manifested early in childhood and forms the basis of personality and individual life attitudes (Hogan et al., 1996); Mischel, 1993.

p18.original: 当说到气质时，心理学家通常指的是一两个持续一生的主要特征，如羞怯或情绪化。这是一个人从出生时就表现出来的人格特征。当然，现代心理学已经抛弃了气质的体液理论，但该理论最基本的理念仍然保留下来了，即生物性特质确实影响我们的基本人格。这一观点得到了研究的支持，心理学家近期发现，存在调节基本人格的大脑结构（LeDoux，2002）。你可能还记得菲尼克斯·盖奇的例子（参见第二章），由于意外事故导致他的额叶受损，由此证明了额叶在调节基本人格方面的作用。这个结果也得到了现代神经科学的证实。
p18.en: When it comes to temperament, psychologists usually refer to one or two of the main features of a lifetime, such as shyness or emotionalization. This is a personal characteristic that a person has displayed since birth. Of course, modern psychology has abandoned the gaseous fluid theory, but the basic idea of the doctrine remains, namely, that biological characteristics do affect our fundamental personality. This view has been supported by research, and psychologists have recently found that there is a brain structure that regulates the basic personality (LeDoux, 2002). You may recall the example of Phoenix Gage (see chapter II), whose forehead was damaged as a result of an accident, thereby demonstrating the role of the forehead in regulating the basic personality. This result is also confirmed by modern neuroscience.

p19.original: 10.5.1 气质的生物学基础是神经递质吗
p19.en: 10.5.1 Is the biological base of the gaseous mass neurotransmitters?

p20.original: 生物心理学家猜测，气质的一些个体差异是由大脑中化学物质的平衡决定的，而这种平衡可能有遗传基础（Azar，2002b；Sapolsky，1992）。从这个意义上说，气质的体液理论仍然存在，只是表现形式不同：现代生物心理学用神经递质取代了体液。因此，抑郁症（大多有自杀想法）可能是由某些递质的失衡引起的。同样，焦虑、愤怒和欣快症都可能起因于神经化学失衡模式。正如发展心理学家杰罗姆·凯根（Jerome Kagan）所说：“我们有相同的神经递质，但每个人的神经递质组合都略有不同。”（Stavish，1994，p.23）凯根认为，这就是人与人之间人格差异的原因。
p20.en: Biopsychologists speculated that some of the individual differences in gas were determined by the balance of chemicals in the brain, which could have a genetic basis (Azar, 2002b); Sapolsky, 1992. In this sense, the gaseous body fluid theory still exists, albeit in different forms: modern biopsychology has replaced body fluids with neurotransmitters. As a result, depression (most of which has suicidal ideas) may have been caused by certain transport imbalances. Similarly, anxiety, anger and aura can all result from neurochemical imbalance patterns. As Jerome Kagan, a development psychologist, said: “We have the same neurotransmitters, but each has a slightly different neurotransmitters mix. According to Keegan, this is the reason for the difference in personality between human beings.

p21.original: 事实上，凯根开展了一个有趣的项目来研究羞怯的遗传基础（Kagan et al.，1994，2005）。这个项目发现，在新生儿出生的第一天，他们对刺激的反应程度就已经有差异了。大约20%的婴儿反应强烈，容易兴奋或紧张；10%的婴儿极其拘谨。虽然有更多的婴儿（35%～40%）在面对新刺激时比较平静，但另外10%的婴儿则显得比较大胆。在生命最初的几个月里，这些初始的差异反映了气质的差异，即许多容易紧张和拘谨的婴儿变得羞怯和内向，较为平静而大胆的婴儿则变得外向。虽然这些反应倾向在一些儿童后续的成长过程中会有所变化，但对大多数儿童来说，这种倾向随时间的推移会保持不变，在11年后的测量中他们还是表现为相同的气质。凯根称之为“自然推动力”的结果。
p21.en: In fact, Keegan has launched an interesting project to study the genetic basis of shyness (Kagan et al., 1994, 2005). The project found that the level of response to the stimulation varied on the first day of the birth of the newborn child. About 20 per cent of infants react strongly and are prone to excitement or stress; Ten per cent of babies are extremely rigid. While more infants (35-40 per cent) are calm in the face of new incentives, 10 per cent are bolder. In the first months of life, these initial differences reflect the differences in the quality of life, in that many babies who are prone to stress and restraint become shy and inward, while the more calm and bold are outward. While these reactions will change in the subsequent development of some children, for most children the trend will remain constant at any time and they will still be of the same quality in the 11-year measurement. Keegan called it the result of the “natural drive”.

p23.original: 40%或更多的大学生都容易羞怯。这个比例远远高于最初拘谨、害羞的婴儿（Zimbardo，1990）。因此，我们可以合理地假设，虽然有些羞怯是遗传的，但更多的羞怯是通过社交生活中的负面经历习得的。初始的气质会影响一个人的经历。例如，如果一个婴儿性格孤僻、容易受惊、不喜欢微笑、害怕陌生人和新事物，那么这个婴儿就不太可能像微笑、开朗的婴儿一样经常被他人抱起来或和他人一起玩耍，从而造成他的成长环境显得不友好或缺乏支持。因此，这种社会刺激的差异让最初拘谨的婴儿变得内向、害羞，而大胆的婴儿则更加外向。通过这种方式，遗传和环境相互作用，随着时间的推移将最初的遗传特点放大（也可能减弱）。这是因为遗传特点向他人发出了“和我一起玩”或“不要理我”的社会信号。
p23.en: Forty percent or more of the university students are vulnerable to shyness. This percentage is much higher than the initial baby, who is Zimbardo, who is shy (Zimbardo 1990). Thus, we can reasonably assume that while some of the shyness is inherited, more shyness is learned through negative experiences in social life. The initial quality affects a person's experience. For example, if a baby is isolated, prone to shock, does not like smiles, fears strangers and new things, then it is unlikely that the baby will be held up or play with others as often as a smiled, open-minded baby, thus making his growth environment look unfriendly or lacking in support. This difference in social stimulation thus makes the first child incarnation, shyness and boldness more outward. In this way, genetic and environmental interactions can magnify (and possibly diminish) the initial genetic characteristics over time. This is because genetic characteristics send a social signal to others to "play with me" or "don't pay attention to me".

p24.original: 一些羞怯是遗传的，另一些是在个人经历和文化规范下习得的。
p24.en: Some of the shyness is inherited, while others are learned under personal experience and cultural norms.

p25.original: 那么，生物学基础能决定你的命运吗？天生的气质可能会决定你在某些生活情境中的反应。然而，气质本身并不能完全决定你的生活经历（Kagan & Snidman，1998）。即使是你的血系亲人和你的遗传基因相似，但你的家庭地位、经历和自我意识也在起作用，共同使你复杂的人格模式不同于他们（Bouchard et al.，1990）。
p25.en: So, can biological foundations determine your fate? It's natural that you may be able to react in certain circumstances. However, the quality of life itself does not entirely determine your life experience (Kagan & Snidman, 1998). Even if your blood line relatives are similar to your genetics, your family status, experience and self-consciousness also work, together making your complex personality model different from them (Bouchard et al., 1990).

p26.en: 10.6 Personality as a combination of characteristics

p28.original: 回顾人格作为组合特质的研究方法。
p28.en: Recall the methodology of the study of personality as a combination of characteristics.

p29.original: 如果你要描述一位朋友，你可能会用某种人格特质来描述：情绪化、开朗、忧郁、热情、善变、友善或聪明。特质（traits）是多维的稳定人格特征，存在于个体内部，并在各种条件下引导其思想和行为。我们可以认为特质是内部心理过程的产物，是动机、情绪和认知的行为表达方式（Winter et al.，1998）。
p29.en: If you want to describe a friend, you might describe it with some kind of personality: emotionalization, openness, depression, enthusiasm, change, kindness or intelligence. Characteristics (traits) are multidimensional and stable features of the person, which are present within the individual and guide his or her ideas and behaviour under various conditions. We can see the characteristics as the product of an internal psychological process and as the expression of motivation, emotion and cognitive behaviour (Winter et al., 1998).

p30.original: 10.6.1 特质和气质有什么不同
p30.en: 10.6.1 What difference does it make between quality and quality?

p31.original: 气质是人格的基础，源于每个人的生物本性。特质是一个建立在气质基础上的多维结构，但也受到经验的影响。特质是在后天教养对天性的扩展中以气质为基础塑造而成的。
p31.en: The quality is the foundation of the personality and derives from the biological nature of each individual. Characteristics are a multidimensional structure based on quality, but also influenced by experience. Characterism is shaped by the aerobics in the context of the expansion of naturality.

p33.original: 特质理论主要关注人格的动机和情绪成分，不考虑智商和创造力。因素分析方法可以帮助学者寻找人格测验不同题目之间的关系或共同属性。因此，学者使用因素分析这种数学方法发现了五种主要的人格因子，这就是著名的五因素理论（five-factor theory）。人格心理学家通常称之为大五人格（Carver & Scheier，2008；John & Srivastava，1999）。
p33.en: Characteristic theory focuses on the motivation and emotional elements of the personality, regardless of IQ and creativity. Factors analysis can help scholars to find relationships or common attributes between different topics of the personality test. Thus, scholars use factors to analyse this mathematical method to find five main personality factors, which are the famous five-factor theory. The personality psychologist is commonly called the Big Five (Carver & Scheier, 2008); John & Srivastava, 1999.

p34.original: 在介绍大五人格特质是什么及其如何影响我们的人格和生活之前，请先完成网上的大五人格测试，了解自己在这些特质上的得分。然后再继续阅读以了解你的分数的意义。
p34.en: Before presenting what the top five characteristics are and how they affect our personality and our lives, please complete an online five-person test and learn your own scores on these characteristics. And then we'll go on reading to see what your scores mean.

p35.original: 现在你已经知道了自己在大五人格特质上的得分。接下来我们逐个描述，告诉你如何利用这一结果。请记住，每一个分数都落在该特质维度的连续体上，所以你的分数表示你的人格中每一个特质的表现程度。同样重要的是，分数高低没有“好坏”之分。相反，最好的做法是利用这些信息来帮助你确定你的优势和劣势，以便你可以最大限度地提高生活满意度。稍后我们会详细介绍这一点，但现在先来看看大五特质。
p35.en: Now you know your score on the five-man character. And then we'll describe it one by one and tell you how to use it. And remember, every fraction falls on the continuum of that characteristic dimension, so your score is the degree of each of your personality's characteristics. Equally important, the scores are not “good or bad”. Rather, it is best to use this information to help you identify your strengths and weaknesses so that you can maximize your satisfaction with life. We'll go into this later, but let's look at the five things first.

p36.original: 开放性（openness to experience）：高分者往往更加好奇、独立、富有想象力、对新想法感兴趣、偏好新奇事物；低分者更喜欢熟悉的事物、抗拒新想法，并且缺乏好奇心。
p36.en: Openness to openness: High-enders tend to be more curious, independent, imaginative, interested in new ideas, and interested in new things; Low-raters prefer familiar things, resist new ideas and lack curiosity.

p37.original: 尽责性（conscientiousness）：高分者可靠、目标导向、坚持、做决策时谨慎；低分者冲动、不可靠、偏好独善其身。
p37.en: Due diligence (conscientiousness): reliable, goal-oriented, committed and prudent decision-making by high-ranked people; The low-scorers are impulsive, unreliable and prefer to be alone.

p38.original: 外倾性（extraversion）：高分者往往善于交际、外向、偏好与人相处；低分者内向、倾向于自我反省，可能看起来羞怯。
p38.en: Extraversion: the high points tend to be friendly, outward-looking and preferred; Introverted and self-reflected, low-specters may seem shy.

p39.original: 宜人性（agreeableness）：高分者温暖、合作、可爱、待人随和，低分者似乎难相处、消极或敌对。
p39.en: Humanistic: High-ranked people are warm, cooperative, lovely, and easy to accommodate, negative or hostile.

p40.original: 神经质（neuroticism）：这个特质是指你体验和表达的情绪有多强烈。因此，高分者焦虑或情绪化，而低分者情绪稳定，甚至坚忍或冷酷。
p40.en: Neuroticism: This is how strongly you experience and express. As a result, high-pointers are anxious or emotionalized, while low-pointers are stable, even patient or cold.

p41.original: 大五人格的缩写OCEAN，代表开放性（Openness to experience）、尽责性（Conscientiousness）、外倾性（Extraversion）、宜人性（Agreeableness）和神经质（Neuroticism）。
p41.en: OCEAN, the acronym of the top five, represents openness, due diligence, extraversion, humanism and neuroticism.

p42.original: 解释特质分数 当你考虑人格的五因素方法时，请记住，分数高低并不代表好坏。你可以用它来更好地了解自己和他人的信息，并帮助你做出最适合自己人格的人生选择。例如，相对于内向，美国文化可能更偏好外向，但两者都可以适应相应的社会和文化环境。内向可能是作家或长途卡车司机这类职业的理想人格，而外向可能是一个销售经理或女老板的首选。同样，我们重视尽责性、开放性、宜人性和情绪稳定性，但在这些特质方面得分较低并不一定是坏事。例如，对于创意达人或政治活动家，遵循自己的理念，不过度被他人左右（宜人性得分较低）是有益的。同样，尽责性水平太高可能会限制一个人把握机会的能力，而过高的开放性可能会使一个人成为“多面手”，却博而不精。与其在我们应该拥有什么特质上费心，不如利用我们所拥有的特质，找到最适合自己的环境。
p42.en: When you consider the five-factor approach to personality, remember, a high-down score doesn't mean good or bad. You can use it to better understand yourself and others and help you make life choices that best fit your personality. For example, American culture may be more outward-oriented than inward, but both can be adapted to the corresponding social and cultural environment. Introverts may be the ideal personality for a profession such as a writer or a long-distance truck driver, while outwards may be the preferred choice of a sales manager or a female owner. Similarly, we attach importance to due diligence, openness, humanity and emotional stability, but it is not necessarily a bad thing to score low on those attributes. For example, it would be useful for creative or political activists to follow their own ideas and not to be overly influenced by others (with low ratings for humanity). Similarly, too high a level of due diligence may limit a person's ability to take advantage of an opportunity, while too high openness may make a person a “multifacer” but unmanageable person. Rather than be concerned about what we should have, we should use what we have to find the best environment for ourselves.

p43.original: 但我们也不能过于简单化。你可以打好你手中的牌以最大限度地利用它们，你也可以尝试寻找你可以努力的方向来接近自己五因素人格的理想水平。例如，如果你想在截止日期前完成承诺，你可以采取哪些步骤让自己变得更有尽责性？如果你发现自己墨守成规，你会如何挑战自我以使自己更加开放？
p43.en: But we cannot be too simplistic. You can play the cards in your hand to maximize their use, and you can try to find the direction you can work to reach the ideal level of your five-factor personality. For example, if you want to meet the deadline, what steps can you take to make yourself more conscientious? How can you challenge yourself to make yourself more open if you find yourself in the right place?

p44.original: 总体来说，五因素理论大大简化了以前的混乱局面。虽然对细节的争论仍在继续，但是，大多数人格心理学家都已经一致认为，我们仅仅用这五个维度就能比较准确地描述个体。考虑到字典上有几百个描述特质的词语，这种简化真是一项了不起的成就（Allport & Odbert，1936）！一些杰出的人格心理学家认为，五因素模型使五花八门的分类法和测量工具变得井然有序（Caprara & Cervone，2000）。研究人员已经发现了影响这些维度上的人格差异的遗传和环境因素（Bouchard & McGue，2003）。
p44.en: Overall, the five-factor theory has considerably simplified the previous confusion. While the debate over details continues, most psychologists have agreed that we can describe individuals more accurately with these five dimensions alone. Considering that the dictionary contains hundreds of terms describing the quality of the term, this simplification is a remarkable achievement (Allport & Odbert, 1936)! Some distinguished personality psychologists believe that the five-factor model has made a variety of taxonomy and measurement tools well organized (Capra & Cervone, 2000). Researchers have identified genetic and environmental factors that influence personality differences in these dimensions (Bouchard & McGue, 2003).

p45.original: 值得注意的是，五因素模型似乎还具有跨文化效度。几项大型研究表明，在欧洲、亚洲、非洲和美洲的50多种文化中，五因素模型都是有效的（McCrae et al.，2005；Schmitt et al.，2007）。但是，我们必须谨慎地对待结论的普遍性，因为这些研究中的样本大多数都是受欧美世界观影响的大学生。因此，样本并不包括可能不符合该模型的文化亚群体。而且，人类学家瑞克·桑德尔（Rick Shweder，1991）提示说，在一些文化中，对人的描述并不是由个人特质组成的；相反，重要的是他们的社会角色、家庭结构中的位置或目标。
p45.en: It is noteworthy that the five-factor model also appears to have cross-cultural effects. Several large studies have shown that five-factor models are effective in more than 50 cultures in Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas (McCrae et al., 2005); Schmitt et al., 2007. But we must be careful about the universality of the conclusions, because most of the samples in these studies are university students affected by the world view of Europe and America. As a result, the sample does not include cultural subgroups that may not conform to the model. Moreover, Rick Shweder, 1991 anthropologist, suggests that in some cultures, the description of human beings is not made up of individual qualities; Rather, what matters is their role in society, their place in the family structure or their goals.

p48.original: 在本节开始时，你完成了大五人格量表在线测试。你的大五人格特征有什么让你感到惊讶的吗？
p48.en: At the beginning of this section, you have completed the test of the five-persons' list online. Is there anything surprising to you about your five-year-old personality?

p49.original: 大五人格特质：地域、死亡率和Facebook风格 大多数人格发展理论都集中在个体水平或人际层面，但美国各州之间人们的人格会有所不同吗？在一项有趣的研究中，超过50万的网民完成了大五人格量表，并登记了他们居住地的邮政编码。然后，研究人员绘制了各州的人格测验分数。对于每一种人格特质，得分前10个州和后10个州的结果揭示了一些与文化氛围一致的有趣模式。
p49.en: Big five personality characteristics: geography, mortality and Facebook style. Most personality development theories are focused on individual levels or interpersonal levels, but will people have different personalities across the states? In an interesting study, more than half a million Internet users completed a five-person scale and registered postal codes for their place of residence. The researchers then drew down the cantonal personality test scores. For each personality, the results of the first 10 states and the second 10 states revealed interesting patterns consistent with the cultural climate.

p50.original: 神经质特征点亮了美国东北区域［联想一下老伍迪·艾伦（Woody Allen）的电影］，但西部和中西部属于情绪稳定区。东北部和西海岸的开放性排名很高，但中西部的开放性较低。宜人性在南方达到顶峰，而在东北部则较低（在那里你可能会听到更多的鸣笛声）。山地和西北部中央区的尽责性得分最高（Rentfrow et al.，2008）。而且，这些人格测验分数甚至与在当时总统选举中哪些州变红和哪些州变蓝相关！支持民主党候选人的各州选民开放性得分较高，神经质得分较低。相比之下，支持共和党候选人的各州选民尽责性得分更高（Rentfrow et al.，2009）。
p50.en: Neural features have lit up the north-eastern region of the United States [thinking about the movie of Woody Allen], but the west and the centrewest are emotional stabilization zones. The north-east and west coasts have a high level of openness, but the centre-west is less open. Humanization peaks in the south, and is lower in the northeast (where you may hear more sirens). The highest score of due diligence was given to the central region of the mountains and north-west (Rentfrow et al., 2008). Moreover, these personality scores were even related to which states had become red and which had become blue in the presidential election at that time! The states that supported the Democratic Party candidates scored higher on the open and lower on the nerve. In contrast, voters in the counties who supported Republican candidates scored higher on due diligence (Rentfrow et al., 2009).

p51.original: 更重要的是，研究发现了两个大五人格因素与死亡率之间的关系。在控制社会人口学因素的情况下，宜人性高的各州公民有明显更长的预期寿命。与热情大方的人生活在一起，你的寿命会延长。神经质得分最高的各州公民的预期寿命明显较低，癌症和心脏病导致的死亡率也较高。
p51.en: More importantly, the study found the relationship between two five-person factors and mortality. In the context of sociodemographic factors, citizens of the more humane cantons have a significantly longer life expectancy. Living with a generous man, your life will increase. Life expectancy is significantly lower among citizens of the states with the highest neurometric scores, and mortality rates due to cancer and heart disease are higher.

p52.original: Facebook用户的人格 有10亿多全球用户的Facebook几乎是最受欢迎的社交媒体网站。人们访问Facebook的频率和方式与大五人格有关吗？是的，2014年，意大利的一项针对Facebook用户的研究发现了这些风格和大五人格之间的一些有趣关联。开放性高的用户往往是Facebook的早期使用者，而尽责性则与较少使用Facebook有关。外向者在Facebook上花更多的时间，也有更多的“好友”，而神经质高分者是使用频率最高的Facebook用户（Caci et al.，2014）。
p52.en: Facebook users have the personality of over a billion users worldwide, and Facebook is almost the most popular social media site. Does the frequency and manner in which people visit Facebook have anything to do with the top five? Yes, in 2014, an Italian study targeting Facebook users found some interesting links between these styles and the top five. The most open users are often early users of Facebook, while due diligence is associated with less use of Facebook. Externals spend more time on Facebook and more “friends”, while the most frequent users of Facebook are those with high nerve scores (Caci et al., 2014).

p53.original: 现在你已经了解了一些关于大五人格的知识，你想知道自己在这五个维度上的位置吗？如果想，那就测试一下吧！
p53.en: Now that you've learned something about the top five, do you want to know your place in these five dimensions? If you want to, test it!

p54.original: 用人格量表测量人格特质 如果你是一名临床心理学家或咨询心理学家，你可能想要使用大五人格量表BFI-54或NEO-PI[2]的纸笔版来评估来访者的大五人格。这些简单但被高度认可的测量方法，已经被用在了有关整个生命周期的人格稳定性、人格特征与身体健康和各种生活事件的关系等方面的研究中。
p54.en: If you're a clinical psychologist or a consulting psychologist, you might want to use BFI-54 or a NEPAD-PI[2] paper and pen version to evaluate the top five of the visitors' personality. These simple but highly accepted measurements have been used in studies on the stability of the personality throughout the life cycle, the relationship of personality characteristics to physical health and various life events.

p55.original: 但是，如果你想要一个测量临床特质（即精神障碍征兆）的工具，那么明尼苏达多相人格量表（MMPI-2，MMPI-2指的是原MMPI的修订版）是一个不错的选择。与BFI-54和NEO-PI不同，MMPI-2不测量大五人格维度。相反，它的10个临床量表（见表10-2）通常被用来评估严重的精神问题，如抑郁症、精神分裂症和妄想症（Helmes & Reddon，1993）。
p55.en: But if you want a tool to measure clinical characteristics (i.e. signs of mental disorders), then the Minnesota Physicological Data Sheet (MPI-2, MMPI-2, the original MMPI revision) is a good option. Unlike BFI-54 and NEO-PI, MMPI-2 does not measure the macro five dimensions. Instead, its 10 clinical tables (see tables 10-2) are usually used to assess serious mental problems, such as depression, schizophrenia and paranoia (Hels & Reddon, 1993).

p56.original: MMPI-2的567个条目涉及各种态度、习惯、恐惧、偏好、身体健康、信念和总体看法。我们不会提供实际的测试项目，但是，这里有一些类似于MMPI-2中的题目的句子。
p56.en: The 567 entries in MMPI-2 cover attitudes, habits, fears, preferences, health, beliefs and general perceptions. We will not offer practical testing projects, but there are sentences similar to those in the MMPI-2 title.

p57.original: 我经常被关于性的想法困扰。
p57.en: I'm often troubled by ideas about sex.

p58.original: 有时我喜欢寻求一些刺激。
p58.en: Sometimes I like to look for some excitement.

p59.original: 如果人们没有不公平地评判我，我可能会更成功。
p59.en: I could have been more successful if people had not judged me unfairly.

p61.original: 答题者被要求回答每句陈述是否描述了他们的真实情况，然后他们的回答将与临床人群中各种已知的精神障碍患者的回答进行比较。因此，量表得分有临床经验作为依据。也就是说，它是通过将每个答题者的反应模式与许多不同临床患者的平均反应或基本反应率进行比较得出的科学数据，而不仅仅是测验编制者的合理假设。
p61.en: Respondents were asked to answer whether each statement described their true situation, and then their responses were compared with those of the various known mentally handicapped in the clinical population. Thus, the scale is based on clinical experience. In other words, it is scientific data by comparing the response patterns of each of the respondents with the average or basic response rates of many different clinical patients, rather than just a reasonable assumption by the test preparers.

p62.original: 接受人格测试（如MMPI-2）的人往往会为自己对某些问题的回答感到苦恼，担心某个“错误”的答案可能导致自己被诊断为精神失常。但其实不用担心！MMPI-2测量的人格特征从来都不是仅仅依赖一个项目或两三个项目。相反，每一个项目仅在次级量表中占一定的权重。
p62.en: People who undergo personality tests (e.g. MMPI-2) are often troubled by their answers to certain questions, and fear that an “mistake” answer may lead to their being diagnosed as mentally disturbed. But don't worry! MMPI-2 measures personality characteristics that have never relied solely on one or two or three projects. On the contrary, each item has only a certain weight in the secondary table.

p63.original: 你能在MMPI-2测试中装好或装坏吗？ 这可能做不到。MMPI-2量表有四个设计巧妙的测谎效度量表。当你在这些效度量表中有太多不寻常的反应时，就表明你的回答有问题。下面是一些类似测谎效度量表的题目。
p63.en: Can you put it in MMPI-2 or break it? This may not be possible. The MMPI-2 scale contains four well-designed polygraphs. When you have too many unusual reactions in these effectiveness tables, it shows that your answer is problematic. Below are some topics similar to the polygraph.

p64.original: 有时我会推迟明知道应该做的事情。
p64.en: Sometimes I delay knowing what to do.

p65.original: 我偶尔也会传一些谣言。
p65.en: I've heard rumors from time to time.

p66.original: 我有时也觉得黄色笑话很好笑。
p66.en: I sometimes find the yellow joke funny.

p67.original: 如果有太多刻意让自己显得很好或很坏的回答，会使测谎量表得分较高，答案会被认为不可信。
p67.en: If there were too many answers that were meant to make themselves look good or bad, the lie-test would score high and the answers would be considered untrustworthy.

p68.original: 从科学的角度来看，有两个原因使MMPI-2、BFI-54和NEO-PI成了测量工具的典范。
p68.en: From a scientific point of view, there are two reasons why MMPI-2, BFI-54 and NEO-PI are models of measurement tools.

p69.original: 1. 这些测验有很好的信度。这意味着随着时间的推移，测验分数仍然保持一致和稳定。所以，当一个人在不同时间完成两次测试时，两次的分数很可能差不多。事实上，任何可用的测验都必须具有良好的信度，否则测验分数将是不稳定和不可靠的。如果个体从时间1到时间2没有变化，那么其测验分数应该保持相对不变。当两次的测验分数确实发生显著变化时，就意味着在这两次测验期间有什么因素影响了个体的心理状态或功能。这就需要对个体的状况保持警惕。
p69.en: 1. These tests have a good degree of faith. This means that test scores remain consistent and stable over time. Thus, when a person completes two tests at different times, the score for both is likely to be similar. In fact, any test available must have a good confidence, otherwise the test scores would be unstable and unreliable. If an individual has not changed from time 1 to time 2, his test scores should remain relatively constant. When the two test scores do change significantly, this means that during the two tests there were factors that affected the psychological state or function of the individual. This requires vigilance with regard to the situation of individuals.

p70.original: 2. 这些测验有良好的效度。这说明这些测验实际测量的确实是测验想要测量的内容，即人格特质或精神障碍征兆。例如，MMPI-2可以可靠地识别抑郁症或精神病患者（Greene，1991）。但我们在非西方文化中使用它时必须谨慎，因为当测验被翻译成其他语言时，它的效度并不明确（Dana，1993）。此外，一些研究人员认为，一些题目可能具有文化特异性内容（Golden & Figueroa，2007）。临床医生在给美国少数族裔做人格测试时同样应该谨慎。因为在最初开发人格测验的样本中，少数族裔的代表性样本量很少（Butcher & Williams，1992；Graham，1990）。
p70.en: 2. The tests are of good effect. This suggests that what these tests actually measure is indeed what they want to measure, i.e. a personal character or signs of mental disorder. For example, MMPI-2 can reliably identify persons suffering from depression or mental illness (Greene, 1991). But we have to be careful to use it in non-Western cultures, because when the tests are translated into other languages, their effectiveness is not clear (Dana, 1993). In addition, some researchers believe that some topics may have cultural specificities (Golden & Figueroa, 2007). Clinicians should be equally cautious when testing the personality of American minorities. Because of the small number of representative samples from ethnic minorities in the original development of the personality test (Butcher & Williams 1992; Graham, 1990.

p71.original: 10.6.3 评价气质理论和特质理论
p71.en: 10.6.3 Evaluation of the gas theory and the quality theory

p72.original: 有学者对气质理论和特质理论及其衍生的测验提出了一些批评。首先，这些理论给出人格的全景概况，将人格描绘成静态的固定画面，而不是随经验发展而变化的动态过程。其次，这些理论仅用几个维度描述人格，把人类复杂的本质过度简单化了。例如，如果我们发现玛丽·卡尔金斯在尽责性等特质上得分很高，但在宜人性上得分较低，那么我们会得到什么结论？虽然这样的描述可能会证实我们观察到的结果，但标签化的描述遗漏了重要的细节，即人格的深层结构。
p72.en: Some criticisms have been made of the qualitative theory and the qualitative theory and the tests derived from it. First, these theories give an overview of the personality, depicting it as static, fixed images, rather than dynamic processes that evolve with experience. Secondly, these theories describe the human personality in only a few dimensions, oversimplifying the complex nature of human beings. For example, if we find Mary Carlkins to have a high score on such qualities as due diligence, but a low score on humanity, what would we conclude? While such a description may confirm the results we have observed, the description of labeling omits important details, namely the deep structure of the personality.

p73.original: 从积极的角度看，特质理论使我们拥有能够预测平常行为的能力。例如，我们可以在工作场景中选择适合某项工作的员工，筛选出那些可能造成麻烦的人。特质理论还可以帮助我们预测哪些教授更可能接受不那么严格的截止日期，或者哪些朋友可以依赖。此外，大五人格确实预测了大多数对我们真正重要的事情，包括健康、学术成就和良好的人际关系，而且准确程度几乎可以与许多医学诊断测试相媲美（Robins，2005）。
p73.en: From a positive point of view, the qualitative theory gives us the ability to predict ordinary behaviour. For example, we can select employees suitable for a job in the work scene and identify those who may cause trouble. Characteristic theory can also help us predict which professors are more likely to accept less stringent deadlines or which friends can rely on. Moreover, the top five do predict most of what is really important to us, including health, academic achievement and good interpersonal relations, and are almost as accurate as many medical diagnostic tests (Robins, 2005).

p74.original: 但归根结底，特质理论仍然存在一个明显的局限：把行为标签化，但并不解释行为。例如，我们可以将随和的人的行为归结为宜人性，或者将外向人格归结为外倾性，但并不真正理解这种人格特征的源头。简而言之，特质理论确定了共同特质，但并没有告诉我们太多这些特征的来源或特质之间如何相互作用（McAdams，1992；Pervin，1985）。
p74.en: In the final analysis, however, there remains a clear limitation to the theory of quality: labelling of behaviour without explaining it. For example, we can classify the conduct of the accompanying person as being humane or the outward personality as being external, but we do not really understand the source of this personality. In short, the quality theory identifies common features, but does not tell us how too many of the sources or features of these characteristics interact (McAdams, 1992); Pervin, 1985.

p75.original: 最后，特质理论遇到了自我实现预言（self-fulfilling prophecy）的问题。当人们被赋予某种特质标签时，他们可能会受到这些标签潜在期望的影响，从而很难改变不良行为。例如，一个被贴上“羞怯”标签的儿童，可能必须同时克服标签化行为和特质。
p75.en: Finally, the theory of quality is confronted with self-fulfilling prophecy. When people are given some kind of quality label, they may be affected by the potential expectations of the labels, making it difficult to change bad behaviour. For example, a child who has been labelled as “weak” may have to overcome both labelling behaviour and characteristics.

p78.original: 描述三种时间取向对决策的影响及其塑造的人格。
p78.en: Describe the impact of three temporal orientations on decision-making and the personality they shape.

p79.original: 生活充满了各种各样的大决定和小决定，有琐碎的，也有意义重大的。去学习还是和朋友聚会？开车回家前是再来一杯啤酒还是叫代驾？周六玩新电子游戏还是写学期论文？从某种意义上说，你的人格是由你所有的决策及行动的总和组成的。
p79.en: Life is full of big decisions and small decisions of all kinds. It is both trivial and significant. To study or to party with friends? Do you want another beer before you drive home? Play a new video game on Saturday or write a term paper? In a sense, your personality consists of the sum of all your decisions and actions.

p80.original: 然而，你决策过程中的主要影响因素是什么呢？
p80.en: However, what are the main influencing factors in your decision-making process?

p81.original: 10.7.1 时间取向如何影响决策

p82.original: 大多数人在做决策时有三种方式。实际上，它们与三种时间取向紧密结合。
p82.en: There are three ways in which most people make decisions. In fact, they are closely linked to three temporal orientations.

p83.original: 1. 对一些人来说，最大的影响来自即时情境的刺激：感知（嗅觉、味觉、视觉、触觉）、生物性驱力（唤醒、饥饿和疲劳）和社会交互（他人的行为、言语和模仿）。这种基于即时信息输入的决策关注现在。如果这是一个人的典型特征，我们可以称之为现在取向（present-oriented）的人格。
p83.en: 1. For some, the greatest impact comes from immediate situational irritation: perception (sniffing, taste, vision, touch), biological drive (awakening, hunger and fatigue) and social interaction (behaviours, words and imitations of others). This decision-making focus, based on the input of instant information, is now in place. If it's a characteristic of a human being, we can call it the person of the current orientation.

p84.original: 2. 另一些人面临同样的决策时则会回顾过去相似的情境，并根据当时的情形决定是否重复过去行为。同样，当这种决策风格成为典型特征时，我们可以认为这个人拥有过去取向（past-oriented）的人格。
p84.en: 2. Others, when faced with the same decision-making, would look back at similar situations in the past and decide whether to repeat past acts in the light of the circumstances at the time. Likewise, when this decision-making style is typical, we can assume that this person has the personality of past-oriented.

p85.original: 3. 还有些人的决策不关注现在或过去，而是考虑想象中的行动及其将来的后果。他们可以快速地进行成本收益估算，在收益大于损失时采取行动。习惯如此行事的人拥有将来取向（future-oriented）的人格。
p85.en: 3. Others do not focus on the present or the past, but rather consider the actions envisaged and their future consequences. They can quickly estimate the cost-benefits and take action when the gain is greater than the loss. Those who are accustomed to doing so have personality for future orientation (future-oriented).

p86.original: 这些主观的时间概念对我们的价值观、判断、决策和行为有很大的影响。时间取向是人们从童年时代的许多经历中学来的，包括文化和社会规范、教育、社会阶层、宗教、家庭和国家的稳定性，以及居住地的纬度。因此，时间取向对我们的影响是无意识的。那些最有可能形成将来时间取向的人通常受教育更多，出身于工业化国家和稳定的家庭，并且不居住在赤道附近（赤道附近的气候几乎不变，所以居住在那里人们更多地拥有现在取向）。
p86.en: These subjective concepts of time have a great impact on our values, judgement, decision-making and behaviour. Time orientations are learned from many experiences of childhood, including cultural and social norms, education, social class, religion, family and national stability, and the latitude of the place of residence. Therefore, the impact of time orientation on us is unconscious. Those who are most likely to develop future time orientations are usually more educated, of industrialized and stable family origin and do not live near the equator (the climate near the equator is almost unchanged, so people living there have more of the current orientation).

p87.original: 10.7.2 测量你的时间取向：津巴多时间观量表
p87.en: 10.7.2 Measuring your time orientation: Zimbabwe timescale

p88.original: 这些构想可以通过一个拥有56道题目的量表测量，要求大学生采用5点量表评分判断每道题目是否符合他们的特点。量表由五种时间观因素构成，有良好的信度和很高的预测效度，被称为津巴多时间观量表（Zimbardo Time Penspective Inventory，ZTPI，Boyd & Zimbardo，2008；Zimbardo & Boyd，1999）。
p88.en: These ideas can be measured through a measurement table of 56 topics, requiring students to use a five-point scale to determine whether each subject is compatible with their characteristics. The scale consists of five temporal factors, with good confidence and a high degree of predictive effect, known as the Zimbabwe timescale (Zimbardo Time Perspective Inventory, ZTPI, Boyd & Zimbardo, 2008); Zimbardo & Boyd, 1999.

p89.original: 下面是五种时间取向因素和每个因素的典型表现。
p89.en: The following are the typical manifestations of the five time-oriented factors and each of them.

p90.original: 1. 将来：在今晚娱乐之前先完成明天截止的任务和其他必要的工作。
p90.en: 1. The future: to complete the tasks to be completed tomorrow and other necessary tasks before the evening entertainment.

p91.original: 2. 现在-享乐主义：我相信和朋友聚会是生活中重要的乐趣之一。
p91.en: 2. Now - Healingism: I believe that gathering with friends is one of the important pleasures of life.

p92.original: 3. 现在-宿命主义：担心未来没有意义，因为我无论如何也无能为力。
p92.en: 3. Now -- Destiny: Fearing the future is meaningless, because I cannot do anything.

p93.original: 4. 过去-积极主义：我更喜欢定期进行的家庭仪式。
p93.en: 4. Past - Active: I prefer regular family rituals.

p94.original: 5. 过去-消极主义：我怀念生命中错过的美好事物。
p94.en: 5. The past — negativeism: I miss the good things that have been missed in my life.

p95.original: （注：要查看自己的时间观得分，请完成ZTPI。）
p95.en: (Note: To see your time score, please complete ZTPI. I don't think so.

p96.original: 在一个由200多人组成的大学生样本中，这些时间取向因素与许多标准人格测验的维度和自我报告的人格特质显著相关（见表10-3）。（如果你在思考这些相关到底有多强，那么请记住，任何人格特质与其他标准人格测验的相关系数通常是在0.2到0.3之间。）
p96.en: In a sample of over 200 university students, these time-oriented factors are significantly related to the dimensions of many standard personality tests and self-reported personality characteristics (see tables 10-3). (If you're thinking about how strong these are, then remember that the coefficients associated with any quality and other standard personality tests are usually between 0.2 and 0.3. I don't think so.

p97.original: 表10-3 五种时间观因素与人格量表的相关
p97.en: Table 10-3 5 Timescale Factors Relevant to Personality Tables

p98.original: 这一切对你意味着什么？ 知道了这些因素之间的关系，你就可以把这些发现用到你自己的行为习惯上，从而了解自己目前的时间取向。例如，在“现在-宿命主义”或“过去-消极主义”上得高分是一种风险信号，因为这些取向通常与不利的特质和经历相关。显然，学业和商业上的成功主要取决于健康的“将来取向”，但是，我们也不能为了成功而成为牺牲朋友、家庭、爱好和睡眠的书呆子或工作狂。而在你激励自己圆满完成任务时，“现在-享乐主义”是必不可少的，但如果过度，人就会变得冲动，对任何快乐之源上瘾，例如，食物、赌博、毒品、性或电子游戏。
p98.en: What does all this mean to you? Knowing the relationship between these factors, you can use these findings to your own habits, so you can understand your current time orientation. For example, high scores on “now-determinism” or “past-negativeism” are a risk signal, as these orientations are usually associated with adverse characteristics and experiences. Clearly, academic and commercial success depends primarily on a healthy “future orientation”, but we cannot be the nerds or work freaks who sacrifice friends, families, hobbies and sleep for success. And when you inspire yourself to complete your mission, “now-honeyism” is essential, but if it is excessive, people become impulsive and addictive to any source of happiness, such as food, gambling, drugs, sex or video games.

p99.original: 强调将来取向时间观和尽责性之间的紧密关系也很重要。为什么呢？因为尽责性是唯一与自然死亡率直接相关的人格特质。在每个年龄段，高尽责性的人都比低尽责性的同龄人和家人至少多活两年！这一强有力的结论是一项包含六个国家9000多人的20项独立研究的元分析结果（Kern & Friedman，2008）。
p99.en: It was also important to highlight the close relationship between the future orientation of time and due diligence. Why? Due diligence is the only personality characteristic directly related to natural mortality. At all ages, high-level due diligence lives at least two more years than low-level peers and families! This strong conclusion is a meta-analysis of 20 independent studies involving more than 9,000 people in six countries (Kern & Friedman, 2008).

p100.original: 尽责性和将来取向之间的这种关系其实并不神奇。如果我们注意到将来取向的学生定期进行体检和牙科检查、参加癌症筛查、保持健康饮食、系安全带、少喝酒、少抽烟，并且不做危险行为，那么这样的结果是显而易见的。你看，他们确实应该比那些没这么做的人更长寿。
p100.en: This relationship between due diligence and future orientation is not really magical. The result is obvious if we note that students in future orientation are regularly examined and examined for dental purposes, are screened for cancers, have a healthy diet, wear seat belts, drink less, smoke less and do no dangerous behaviour. You see, they really should live longer than those who didn't.

p101.original: 但是，时间取向是一种人格特质吗？ 除了上述内容之外，我们还需要哪些信息才能回答这个问题？我们是不是可以通过五种时间取向因素与大五人格的显著相关关系来确定（Costa & Mccrae，1992a）？立陶宛的一篇学位论文做了尝试，并发现了令人惊奇的支持证据（Kairys，2010）。
p101.en: But is time-oriented a character? In addition to the above, what information do we need to answer this question? Can we determine the significant correlation between five time-oriented factors and the top five (Costa & McCrae, 1992a)? An attempt was made on a degree paper in Lithuania and surprising evidence of support was found (Kaerys, 2010).

p102.original: 表10-4 时间观和大五人格的具体关系
p102.en: Table 10-4 Timescale and Specific Relationships of the Big Five

p103.original: 这项研究测试了700多人，包括三个不同年龄段的男女群体：年轻人（18～22岁），中年（30～50岁），老年人（60岁以上），研究结论适用于欧洲国家跨年龄和性别的大样本。结果表明，时间取向与大五人格特质高度相关。因此，“时间取向应该属于人格特质的范畴”（Kairys，2010，pp.27、28）。
p103.en: The study tested more than 700 people, including three different age groups of men and women: young people (18-22 years), middle-aged people (30-50 years) and older people (60 years and over), and the findings applied to large samples across age and gender in European countries. The results show that the time orientation is highly correlated with the five-person characteristic. Thus, “time orientation should be in the context of personality” (Kaerys, 2010, pp. 27, 28).

p104.original: 那么，时间取向和大五人格的具体关系是怎样的呢？
p104.en: So, what is the specific relationship between time orientation and the top five?

p105.original: 值得注意的是，尽管“现在-享乐主义”随着年龄的增长而减少，但时间取向因素与人格特质之间的关系不存在年龄差异。随着时间的推移，人们的时间观取向相对稳定。在后续的研究和分析中，凯瑞斯和利尼奥斯凯特（Kairys & Liniauskaite，2015）得到了高度一致的结果。
p105.en: It is worth noting that, while “now-honeylandism” decreases with age, there is no age difference in the relationship between time-oriented factors and personality characteristics. Over time, people's temporal orientation has been relatively stable. In the follow-up research and analysis, the results were highly consistent with those of Kairys & Linauskaite 2015.

p106.original: 最后，一些学者提出，如果某些时间取向因素的组合反映了时间观的平衡，那么它就能够比现有的任何人格特质测量工具更好地预测一系列行为。这种时间观的平衡指高过去-积极主义、中等偏高的将来取向、中等的现在-享乐主义、低水平的现在-宿命主义和过去-消极主义。如果其他研究证实了时间视角在将个人与一系列行为联系起来方面的预测能力，那么时间取向可以被看作人类人格的核心过程（Muro et al.，2014；Usart & Romero，2014；Zhang & Howell，2014）。
p106.en: Finally, some scholars argue that if the combination of certain time-oriented factors reflects the balance of the time view, it will be able to predict a range of behaviours better than any existing human quality measurement tool. This balance of time refers to the high past — activeism, medium-high future orientation, medium-current — pleasureism, low-level presentism — fatalism and the past — negativeism. If other studies confirm the predictive ability of the temporal perspective to link individuals to a range of behaviours, time orientation can be seen as the core process of human personality (Muro et al., 2014); Usart & Romero, 2014; Zhang & Howell, 2014.

p107.original: 我们希望你能更深入地思考你的时间取向以及你的行为是否受到你的无意识想法的影响。一旦你意识到这一点，你就可以尝试采用更理想的时间取向，这使你能够根据生活情境的需求灵活地转换时间取向。另一种选择是成为时间的奴隶，困在过去，囿于未来的超负荷，或者沉迷于当下的无所事事。我们的建议是你可以及时行乐，但那是在通过考试之后。
p107.en: We hope that you will reflect more deeply on your timing and whether your behaviour is influenced by your unconscious thoughts. Once you are aware of this, you can try to adopt a more ideal time orientation, which allows you to change time orientation flexibly according to the needs of the circumstances of life. Another option is to become a slave of time, trapped in the past, overloaded in the future, or obsessed with the present. Our advice is you can have fun in time, but that's after the exams.

p108.original: 心理学很有用 作为人格和幸福核心的积极性
p108.en: Psychology is useful. It's a motivation at the heart of personality and happiness.

p109.original: 几个世纪以来，学者们一直在寻找开启人类人格复杂性之门的钥匙，包括体液、气质、特质、类型和个人档案，以及各种类型的测量工具。来自罗马的一个意大利研究团队认为，他们发现了神奇的钥匙，即可以通过“积极性”的概念简化人格核心。他们认为这是人类最佳机能和幸福的核心（Caprara & Alessandri，2014）。但是，什么是积极性呢？我们仔细看看这个有趣的新概念，已经有研究证明它与主观幸福感的许多决定性因素有着重要关系，而且似乎包含遗传因素。
p109.en: For centuries, scholars have been looking for the keys to opening the door to the complexity of human personality, including body fluids, gas, features, types and personal files, as well as various types of measurement tools. An Italian research team from Rome believed that they had discovered the magical key that could simplify the core of personality through the concept of “motivation”. They see this as the core of the best functioning and well-being of humanity (Capra & Alessandri, 2014). But what is motivation? We look closely at this interesting new concept, which has been shown to be relevant to many of the determinants of subjective well-being and which appear to contain genetic factors.

p110.original: 积极性（Positivity）被定义为一个人对自我、生活和未来的积极评价。在所有的基本人格特质中，对生活经历采取积极态度的这种倾向，可以使人更珍视自己和他人的生活。尽管人类的存在是脆弱的，但这是一个事实。这个事实可以使我们能够通过自律、能力和社会联系来努力实现自我。这种基本的特质能使我们以积极的态度评价所有的生活经历，是我们成长、绽放，应对逆境、失败和损失，以及在面对衰老和死亡时继续热爱生活所必需的。
p110.en: Positiveness is defined as a person's positive assessment of his or her self, life and future. This tendency to adopt a positive attitude to life experiences among all the basic personality characteristics can make one more valued for one's life and that of others. Although human existence is fragile, it is a fact. This fact can enable us to work towards self-regulation, capacity and social cohesion. This basic trait enables us to evaluate all life experiences in a positive manner, as necessary for our growth, for our flourishing, for dealing with adversity, for our failures and losses, and for our continued love in the face of ageing and death.

p111.original: 越来越多的研究（包括双生子研究和跨文化研究）发现积极性是一个核心的性格特征，包括情感和认知成分（Caprara et al.，2012；Fagnani et al.，2014）。因此，它提倡一种对生活和体验的态度，这种态度广泛地影响着个人与自身和外部世界的关系。免疫学和脑成像研究的发现进一步证实了这一假设，即这种性格是我们心理禀赋的一个基本组成部分（Alessandri et al.，2015）。最近，许多研究也证实了它对许多领域的最优功能的影响：促进支持性人际关系，提高工作绩效和成就，缓解严重疾病的不良后果（Caprara & Alessandri，2014；Livi et al.，2015）。因此，积极性可以作为生命本能的隐喻，因为它是服务于我们提升生活质量的一种强大力量。
p111.en: An increasing number of studies (including twin-child studies and intercultural studies) have identified motivation as a core character, including emotional and cognitive components (Caparra et al., 2012); Fagnani et al., 2014). It therefore promotes an attitude to life and experience that has a broad impact on the relationship between the individual and himself and the outside world. The findings of immunology and brain imaging studies further confirm the assumption that this character is an essential component of our psychological endowment (Alessandri et al., 2015). Many recent studies have also confirmed its impact on its optimal functions in many areas: promoting supportive human relationships, improving performance and achievements and mitigating the adverse consequences of serious diseases (Capra & Alessandri, 2014); Livi et al., 2015. So motivation can be a metaphor for the instinct of life, because it is a powerful force that serves us to improve the quality of life.
